latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Video Editor for Instagram.
- Instantly edit and export videos optimized for Instagram Reels and Stories.
- Upload MP4, MOV, AVI, or WebM files up to 500MB and describe edits (crop, captions, trim).
- Automatic AI editing and fast cloud rendering (30–60 seconds per clip).
- Simple connection process—no complex software needed.
- Easily check credits, session status, and export/download videos via chat commands.
